items.information:
**The Bolivia Cubing Tour Santa Cruz 2025** will be the first competition of an exciting tour that will take place **in four different cities across Bolivia, between January 19 and 26**. This will be the perfect opportunity for competitors from all over the country to join a unique speedcubing experience, enjoying thrilling tournaments in various locations.
This competition is open to all public. To see all the information about register payment go to the next [link](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BoliviaCubingTourSCZ2025#52958-informacion-de-pago-payment-information)

**More information about the competitions enter to: [Frequently Asked Questions / FAQ]      (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BoliviaCubingTourSCZ2025#52960-faq-pmf)**

**El Bolivia Cubing Tour Santa Cruz 2025** será la primera competencia de un emocionante tour que se llevará a cabo en **cuatro ciudades diferentes de Bolivia, entre el 19 y el 26 de enero**. Esta será la oportunidad perfecta para los competidores de todo el país de unirse a una experiencia única de speedcubing, disfrutando de emocionantes torneos en distintas localidades.
Esta competencia esta abierta a todo publico. Para ver la informacion acerca del pago de inscripcion entra al siguiente [link](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BoliviaCubingTourSCZ2025#52958-informacion-de-pago-payment-information)

**Mas informacion acerca de las competencias ingresar a: [Preguntas frecuentes / FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BoliviaCubingTourSCZ2025#52960-faq-pmf)**

items.name: UCSD Big and Blind 2025

venue.name: UC San Diego
venue.address: Price Center, UCSD, 9500 Gilman Dr, La Jolla, CA 92093

items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UCSDBigandBlind2025#43214-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating.

This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/).

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png)

#### SacCubing returns with our 19th iteration! Make sure to sign up early to reserve your spot!

*  *If we run ahead of schedule, we will start first round events no earlier than 20 minutes, so please show up at least 20 minutes before your first event.*
* We will be assigning judging assignments to competitors for the group before or after their own competing groups. Please check your personal competitor cards when we assign them a week before the competition date for relevant info.
* All donations are appreciated and will go towards things such as venue fees, supplies and other competition expenses.

items.name: Peace and Quiet Palisades 2025

venue.name: Palisades Center
venue.address: 1000 Palisades Center Dr, West Nyack, NY 10994
venue.details: 4th Floor, Harry & Thelma Adler Community Room

items.information:
This competition only has the blindfolded events and Fewest Moves. If you're looking for a more conventional cubing competition, you might be interested in [this one](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PBsinPalisadesOpen2025).

Due to the limited space, each competitor can bring at most 1 guest during the competition.
The Harry & Thelma Adler community room is located on the 4th floor in front of the Ice Skating Rink on your right hand side.

This competition is a fundraiser for [Flushing Town Hall](https://www.flushingtownhall.org/)

items.name: DFW Cubing Winter 2025
items.information:
Note: This competition is on a Sunday.

- Please review the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWCubingWinter2025#48388-competitor-information) tab before the competition.
- Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition.

Please note that the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWCubingWinter2025#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule. 

## ***Please note that no outside food/drink will be permitted in the venue.*** 

This competition is supported by Southern Cubing LLC. To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/).
